title: MX Shooting Calculator export
description: A file of the hunter's own records: an export, a backup or a sync copy.

format.description:
Always `mxsc/personal-data`. Files from the app's earlier names say
`mhc/personal-data` or `ballistic-calculator/personal-data`.

version.description:
The format's version; this description is of version 8. A reader
should refuse versions newer than it knows.

exported_at.description: When the file was written, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

bullets.description: The hunter's bullets: factory ammunition and handloads.

rifle_loads.description:
What is particular to a bullet in a rifle: measured velocities,
point of impact, zero weather and truing.

scopes.description: Scopes the hunter entered (catalog scopes are only named by id).

targets.description: Targets the hunter made or copied (catalog targets aren't included).

shots.description:
The shot log: shots the hunter took, with the solution the app gave
and, after a shot at game, where the hunter and the animal stood.

barrels.description: Barrels of the hunter's rifles, fitted or not.

round_log.description: Rounds fired, for the round counts of actions and barrels.

zero_resets.description: When rifles' zeros were set again.

sessions.description: Days at the range, with their weather.

photos.description:
What is known about the target photos groups are marked on. The
photos themselves are not in the file.

groups.description:
Shot groups: shots marked on a photo or a grid, with what, where and
how they were shot.

analyses.description: Saved comparisons and composites of groups.

deleted.description: Records deleted, so merging the file deletes them elsewhere too.

catalog.description:
The catalog entries the records refer to by id, written out so the
file can be read without the app. Only in exported files; importing
ignores it.

Rifle.description: A rifle: its caliber, barrel, scope and zero.

id.description: The rifle's id, unique among rifles.

name.description: The hunter's name for the rifle.

caliber.description:
The caliber's key in the app's catalog, e.g. `6-5x55-se` (see
`catalog`).

twist_in.description: Barrel length for one turn of the rifling, in inches.

right_hand_twist.description:
Whether the rifling turns to the right (clockwise seen from behind), as
most do.

sight_height_cm.description: Height of the scope's axis above the bore's axis.

zero_range_m.description: The range the rifle is zeroed at.

zero_height_cm.description:
Where the zero puts the bullet at the zero range: above (positive)
or below the line of sight, cm. Hunters often zero "4 cm high at
100 m"; zero for a plain zero.

zero_temperature_c.description: Air temperature when the rifle was zeroed.

zero_pressure_hpa.description:
Air pressure when the rifle was zeroed, as a barometer at the range
reads it (not reduced to sea level).

zero_powder_temperature_c.description: Powder temperature at the zero; `None` means the air temperature.

zero_humidity_percent.description: Relative humidity when the rifle was zeroed.

table.description: The range table's ranges and columns.

click_unit.description: The unit of the scope's clicks.

click_value.description:
One click of the turrets, in `click_unit`: 0.1 for 0.1 mil, 0.25 for 1/4
MOA.

scope_id.description:
The mounted scope: the id of one of the file's `scopes`, or of a
scope in the app's catalog (see `catalog`); `null` for none.

reticle_id.description: The scope's reticle: the id of a reticle in the app's catalog.

fitted_barrel_id.description:
The barrel on the rifle now: one of the file's `barrels`; `null`
when the hunter keeps no barrels for it.

rounds_before_logging.description:
Rounds fired through the action before the hunter began the round
log (`round_log`); the logged rounds add to it.

updated_at.description:
When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).
Merging keeps the copy changed last.

TableSettings.description: The rifle's range table: which ranges and which columns.

TableColumns.description:
Which range table columns to show besides the range. Elevation and
wind are corrections: what to dial or hold, up and right positive.

drop_length.description: Where a dead-on hold hits, above (+) or below the aim, as a length.

hit_chance.description:
The chance of hitting the target's vital zone or hit area at each
range, from the shooter's precision. Shown only for a target that
has one.

ClickUnit.description: The unit of a scope's clicks as the rifle stores it.

Bullet.description:
A bullet in the hunter's own collection: either factory ammunition or a
handload. Only these can be chosen when calculating.

id.description: The bullet's id, unique among bullets.

caliber.description: Caliber key of the cartridge this is loaded in.

mass_g.description: Bullet weight in grams (7000 grains a pound: 1 gr = 0.0648 g).

length_mm.description:
Bullet length, for stability, spin drift and aerodynamic jump; `null`
when not known.

drag_model.description: Which of the two BCs the calculation uses.

bc_bands.description:
BCs for velocity bands under `drag_model`; when present they replace
the single BC in the calculation.

drag_curve.description: Drag coefficient by Mach number, used when `drag_model` is `Custom`.

muzzle_velocity_mps.description:
Muzzle velocity: the maker's for factory ammunition, the hunter's for a
handload.

velocity_temperature_c.description: Temperature the muzzle velocity was measured at.

velocity_per_degree.description: Change in muzzle velocity per °C of powder temperature, in m/s.

test_barrel_mm.description: Length of the barrel the maker's velocity was measured in, if known.

min_expansion_mps.description: The least impact speed at which it expands, as the maker gives it.

catalog_id.description: The catalog entry this was copied from, if any.

data_attribution.description:
Attribution for copied data. Preserve it when sharing or adapting the
record, even if the catalog entry is no longer available.

recipe.description: How a handload is loaded, if the hunter wrote it down.

updated_at.description:
When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).
Merging keeps the copy changed last.

BulletKind.description: Factory ammunition or the hunter's own load.

oneOf.description: Factory-loaded cartridge: the velocity comes from the box.
A component bullet loaded by the hunter: the velocity is their own.

BcModel.description: How the bullet's drag is described.

oneOf.description: A G1 ballistic coefficient (`bc_g1`).
A G7 ballistic coefficient (`bc_g7`).
The bullet's own drag curve (`drag_curve`) instead of a BC.

BcBand.description:
One point of a velocity-dependent BC: the BC that applies at a velocity.
Between points the BC is interpolated linearly by the bullet's speed
through the air; below the slowest point and above the fastest it stays
at that point's BC.

velocity_mps.description:
The speed this BC applies at, in m/s. A maker's band that covers a
range of speeds (for example "above 2600 ft/s") is best given at the
middle of that range.

bc.description: The BC (of the bullet's `drag_model`) at that speed.

DragPoint.description: One point of a bullet's own drag curve.

Construction.description:
How the bullet is made, which decides whether it expands (and so its
legal class for game): `fmj` and `match` don't, `other` is unknown, and
the rest do.

DataAttribution.description:
Attribution and license terms for data copied from another collection.
These describe the copied data, not the user's independent notes or the app's code.

credit.description: The creator or collection that must receive credit.

source_url.description:
HTTPS URL where the copied record can be found. Other URL schemes
are rejected when storing or importing the record.

source_revision.description: Revision of the source collection used for the import.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for the copied data, e.g. `CC-BY-SA-4.0`.

license_url.description:
HTTPS URL of the license text or canonical license page. Other URL
schemes are rejected when storing or importing the record.

changes.description:
Changes made in the initial catalog adaptation. Personal copies may
contain later user edits.

Recipe.description: How a handload is put together. Every part may be left blank.

charge_g.description: The powder charge, in grams (1 grain = 0.0648 g).

cbto_mm.description:
Cartridge base to ogive (CBTO), mm: the length that sets how far the
bullet jumps to the rifling.

notes.description: The hunter's notes on the recipe.

RifleLoad.description:
A bullet as shot from one particular rifle: chronographed velocities,
where it hits relative to the rifle's zero, and the weather it was zeroed
in. Everything here overrides the bullet's general data for this rifle.

id.description: The load's id, unique among loads.

velocities.description: Measured velocities; empty means the bullet's own velocity is used.

impact_offset_mrad.description:
Where this load hits relative to the rifle's zero, as an angle in
mrad: [right, up].

zero.description: Which weather this load's zero was made in.

truing.description: A long shot the calculation was trued to, if any.

updated_at.description:
When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).
Merging keeps the copy changed last.

VelocityPoint.description: One chronograph result: the average muzzle velocity at a temperature.

temperature_c.description: The cartridges' (powder's) temperature when they were shot.

shots.description: The string it averages, when imported from a chronograph.

ShotStats.description: How a string of shots spread.

count.description: How many shots the average is of.

sd_mps.description: Standard deviation (of a sample: n − 1), m/s.

es_mps.description: Extreme spread, fastest less slowest, m/s.

LoadZero.description: Which weather a load's zero was made in.

oneOf.description: The rifle's zero weather.
The same weather as the shot, so the weather needs no correction.

ZeroWeather.description: Weather when a rifle was zeroed.

pressure_hpa.description: Air pressure as a barometer there reads it (not reduced to sea level).

Truing.description:
A long shot that showed where the calculation was off, and the factor
found to make it match.

elevation_mrad.description: What it took to hit centre: elevation in mrad, up positive.

factor.description: The velocity or drag multiplier that makes the calculation match.

TruingMethod.description: What truing adjusts to make the calculation match a real shot.

oneOf.description: Scale the muzzle velocity: for loads without a chronograph.

Scale the bullet's drag (its BC the other way): for loads whose
velocity was measured.

UserScope.description:
A scope the hunter entered: one that isn't in the catalog, or one set up
differently. Part of the personal data, exported and imported with it.

id.description: The scope's id, unique among scopes; rifles name it in `scope_id`.

reticle_reference_magnification.description:
For second-focal-plane scopes: the magnification at which the reticle's
marks are true.

fov_m_at_100m.description:
Field of view in metres at 100 m, at the lowest and the highest
magnification.

illuminated.description: Whether the reticle can be lit.

reticle_id.description: A catalog reticle to draw; `None` draws a plain crosshair.

updated_at.description:
When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).
Merging keeps the copy changed last.

oneOf.description:
First focal plane: the reticle grows with the image, so its marks are
true at every magnification.

Second focal plane: the reticle stays the same size, so its marks are
true only at one magnification.

Centimetres at 100 metres, common on European hunting scopes; 1 cm at
100 m is 0.1 mrad.

Target.description:
What is shot at: a game animal, whose vital zone and least energy set
the ethical range, or a sport target and its hit zone. Drawn at true
size by its `shape`.

id.description: The target's id, unique among targets.

kind.description: Game, with ethical limits, or a sport target.

vital_diameter_cm.description:
The zone a shot must land in: the heart–lung area of an animal, or
the part of a sport target that counts as a hit.

min_energy_j.description: Least energy the bullet must carry at the target. Only for game.

min_velocity_mps.description:
Least impact velocity this game asks for, instead of the hunter's
general one (zero: no expansion needed, as for small game).

group.description: Where it is listed; `None` for the hunter's own until they choose.

other_names.description: Other names to find it by, such as the Swedish and Finnish ones.

ammunition.description:
The least rifle ammunition level (class) each country's rules ask
for, where it is game there; 1 is the strictest.

rules_notes.description:
What else each country's rules say about it ("a shotgun is allowed
too").

catalog_id.description: The catalog target a custom one was copied from.

updated_at.description:
When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC);
zero for catalog targets.

oneOf.description: An animal standing broadside.

silhouette.description:
The drawing used, by name (the app's animal drawings, e.g.
"moose" or "black-grouse"), scaled to the sizes below.

body_length_cm.description: Rump to nose, without the tail.

antlers.description: Draw antlers (when the silhouette has them).

oneOf.description:
A paper target with evenly spaced scoring rings and a black aiming
area.

step_mm.description: How much each ring is wider than the one inside it.

oneOf.description: A round steel plate.

TargetKind.description: Game, with ethical limits, or a sport target.

TargetGroup.description: How targets are grouped in lists, the way hunters think of the game.

Shot.description: A shot taken, with the solution the app gave and what came of it.

id.description: The shot's id, unique among shots.

taken_at.description: When it was logged, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

rifle_id.description: The rifle shot with; it may have been deleted since.

rifle_name.description:
The rifle's name then, so the log reads after it is renamed or
deleted.

target_id.description:
What was shot at: one of the hunter's targets or the catalog's, or
`None` for no target.

range_m.description: The range along the line of sight.

inclination_degrees.description: The shot angle: up (positive) or down the line of sight.

wind_clock.description: Where the wind came from, on a clock: 12 head-on, 3 from the right.

weather.description: The weather the solution was worked out for.

solution.description: The bullet's path at the range.

outcome.description: Hit, miss or not written down.

hit_where.description: Where a hit landed, in the hunter's words ("heart–lung").

position.description: Where the hunter stood, if they marked it.

bearing_degrees.description:
The direction from the hunter to the animal, degrees from true
north, if taken.

animal_spot.description:
Where the animal stood, from `position`, `bearing_degrees`, the
range and the shot angle; `None` without a position and a bearing.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

ShotWeather.description: The weather the solution was worked out for.

pressure_hpa.description:
Air pressure where the hunter stood, as a barometer there reads it
(not reduced to sea level).

ShotHold.description:
The hold the app gave: the angle to come up and right by, and the same
in the rifle's clicks.

click_unit.description: The unit of the rifle's clicks then.

elevation_clicks.description: Clicks up (positive) or down, rounded to whole clicks.

ShotSolution.description: Where the bullet was worked out to be at the range, aimed dead on.

drop_cm.description: Above (positive) or below the line of sight.

windage_cm.description: Right (positive) or left of the line of sight: wind and spin drift.

time_of_flight_s.description: Seconds from the muzzle to the range.

oneOf.description: Not written down (yet).
The shot hit.
The shot missed.

ShooterPosition.description: Where the hunter stood when shooting.

accuracy_m.description:
How far off the position may be, as the device said; `None` when
it was typed in.

AnimalSpot.description:
Where the animal stood, worked out from the hunter's position, the
bearing and the range.

search_radius_m.description:
How far around the spot to search: the bearing's, the range's and
the position's possible errors together.

Barrel.description: A barrel that is or was on one of the hunter's rifles.

id.description: The barrel's id, unique among barrels.

rifle_id.description: The rifle (one of the file's `rifles`) the barrel belongs to.

name.description: The hunter's name for it, e.g. `Factory` or `Bartlein 26"`.

twist_in.description:
Barrel length for one turn of the rifling, in inches; `null` when not
known.

right_hand_twist.description: Whether the rifling turns to the right, as most do.

fitted_at.description:
When it was fitted to the rifle, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC), if
known.

retired_at.description: When it came off for good; `null` while it is still in use.

rounds_before_logging.description:
Rounds fired through it before the hunter began the round log; the
logged rounds add to it.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

RoundLogEntry.description: Rounds fired through a rifle at one time, for the round counts.

id.description: The entry's id, unique among round log entries.

rifle_id.description: The rifle fired (one of the file's `rifles`).

barrel_id.description:
The barrel they went through (one of the file's `barrels`); `null`
when the hunter keeps no barrels for the rifle or didn't say: then
they count for the action only.

at.description: When they were fired, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

group_id.description:
The group (one of the file's `groups`) these rounds were, when the
entry was made by saving one. Such an entry's id is the UUID (version
5) of the group's id in the namespace
`6d787363-726f-756e-6473-8f2a41c6d903`, so every device makes the same
one.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

Clean.description: A cleaning of a rifle's barrel.

id.description: The clean's id, unique among cleans.

rifle_id.description: The rifle cleaned (one of the file's `rifles`).

barrel_id.description:
The barrel cleaned (one of the file's `barrels`); `null` for a rifle
whose barrels the hunter doesn't keep apart.

note.description: The hunter's note, e.g. what was used.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

ZeroReset.description:
The moment a rifle's zero was set again (a new scope, a new mount, a
new zero): zero checks pool only the groups shot since.

id.description: The reset's id, unique among zero resets.

barrel_id.description:
The barrel (one of the file's `barrels`) the zero is for; `null` for
the rifle whatever its barrel.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

Session.description:
A day or an outing at the range. Groups name the session they were shot
in and take its conditions unless they have their own.

id.description: The session's id, unique among sessions.

place.description: Where, in the hunter's words (a range's name, not a position).

started_at.description: When it began, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

powder_temperature_c.description:
The cartridges' (powder's) temperature, when it differs from the
air's.

pressure_hpa.description:
Air pressure as a barometer at the range reads it (not reduced to sea
level).

wind_clock.description: Where the wind came from, on a clock: 12 head-on, 3 from the right.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

Photo.description:
A photo of a target that groups are marked on. Only its description is
in the file; the photo itself is kept on the device beside the data.

id.description:
The lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the kept photo's bytes, which
also names it where it is kept.

width_px.description: Its width as kept: upright, after any reduction.

mime.description: The type of the kept bytes, `image/jpeg`.

taken_at.description:
When the camera says it was taken, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC);
`null` when it doesn't say.

calibration.description:
How its pixels map to millimetres on the target, for every group
marked on it; `null` until the scale is set.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

Calibration.description:
How a photo's pixels map to millimetres on the target. Points are in the
photo's pixels: x to the right and y down from the photo's top-left
corner, so the middle of the top-left pixel is `[0.5, 0.5]`.

oneOf.description:
Two points a known distance apart on the target, such as lines of
its grid: gives the scale, the photo taken to face the target
squarely.

distance_mm.description: How far apart the two points are on the target.

oneOf.description:
The corners of a rectangle of known size on the target, such as the
sheet's edges: gives the scale and straightens a photo taken at an
angle.

corners_px.description:
The rectangle's corners as `[x, y]`: its top left, top right,
bottom right and bottom left.

width_mm.description: The rectangle's width: from its top-left to its top-right corner.

height_mm.description:
The rectangle's height: from its top-right to its bottom-right
corner.

ordered.description:
`true` when the corners are the rectangle's own top left, top
right, bottom right and bottom left, whichever way the photo
shows them, as found from a printed MX target's marks: the
target's up is then the rectangle's, not the photo's. `false`
(or left out) for corners tapped on the photo, which are taken
in the order the photo shows them.

Group.description:
A group of shots: where they went, and what, where and how they were
shot.

id.description: The group's id, unique among groups.

taken_at.description: When it was shot, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

rifle_id.description: The rifle shot (one of the file's `rifles`), if given.

barrel_id.description: The rifle's barrel (one of the file's `barrels`), if given.

bullet_id.description: The bullet or load shot (one of the file's `bullets`), if given.

ladder_id.description: The ladder (one of the file's `ladders`) this group is a rung of.

rung_value.description:
The rung's value, in the unit the ladder's `variable` names: the
charge in grams, or the seating's CBTO in mm.

charge_g.description:
The handload's powder charge when the group was saved, in grams, as
its bullet's `recipe` gave it; `null` when it gave none (a factory
load, or a group saved before this was kept).

cbto_mm.description:
The handload's cartridge base to ogive (CBTO) when the group was
saved, mm, as its bullet's `recipe` gave it; `null` when it gave none.

distance_m.description:
The distance to the target; `null` when not given, which leaves out
sizes as angles.

session_id.description: The session (one of the file's `sessions`) it was shot in.

conditions.description:
Conditions that differ from the session's; what is `null` here is
the session's.

extra_velocities_mps.description:
Muzzle velocities measured for rounds that match no marked shot
(foulers, shots off the paper), in the order they came.

dialled_offset_mrad.description:
What was dialled on the scope, right and up positive, compared with
the zero. Zero checks take it off the group's impact.

include_in_zero.description: Whether zero checks count this group.

count_rounds.description:
Whether saving the group logs its shots as rounds fired (an entry of
`round_log` naming the group).

archived.description: Kept, but out of the library's lists.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

Marks.description: Where a group's shots are marked.

oneOf.description: On a photo of the target.
On a blank grid.

PhotoShot.description: A shot marked on a photo.

x_px.description: The hole's centre: pixels from the photo's left edge.

y_px.description: The hole's centre: pixels down from the photo's top edge.

cold_bore.description: The first shot from a cold, clean barrel.

called_flier.description:
The shooter knew the shot was bad as it broke; statistics can leave
it out.

PhotoMarks.description: Shots marked on a photo of the target, in its pixels.

photo_id.description:
The photo (one of the file's `photos`), whose `calibration` gives the
scale.

aim_px.description:
The point aimed at, `[x, y]` in pixels; `null` without one, which
leaves out the group's correction and zero checks.

shots.description: The shots, in the order they were marked.

GridShot.description: A shot placed on a blank grid.

x_mm.description: Millimetres right (positive) or left of the grid's centre.

y_mm.description: Millimetres up (positive) or down from the grid's centre.

cold_bore.description: The first shot from a cold, clean barrel.

called_flier.description:
The shooter knew the shot was bad as it broke; statistics can leave
it out.

GridMarks.description:
Shots placed on a blank grid at true scale, in millimetres from its
centre: x to the right, y up. For targets that weren't photographed:
scored paper, or positions from an electronic target.

aim_mm.description:
The point aimed at, `[x, y]` in mm; `null` without one. Usually the
centre, `[0, 0]`.

shots.description: The shots, in the order they were placed.

Conditions.description:
The weather at the range. Every part may be unknown, and is then left
out.

powder_temperature_c.description:
The cartridges' (powder's) temperature, when it differs from the
air's.

pressure_hpa.description:
Air pressure as a barometer at the range reads it (not reduced to sea
level).

wind_clock.description: Where the wind came from, on a clock: 12 head-on, 3 from the right.

Ladder.description:
A load development: groups of one bullet in one rifle, each a rung at a
different charge or seating depth (the groups' `ladder_id` and
`rung_value`). Zero checks and trends leave its groups out unless the
hunter adds them.

id.description: The ladder's id, unique among ladders.

name.description: The hunter's name for it; may be empty.

bullet_id.description:
The bullet loaded (one of the file's `bullets`), whose recipe the
rungs vary.

variable.description: What changes from rung to rung.

promoted_bullet_id.description:
The load (one of the file's `bullets`) made from the rung the hunter
kept, once there is one.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

LadderVariable.description: What a ladder varies from rung to rung.

oneOf.description: The powder charge; rung values are grams.

The seating depth; rung values are the cartridge's base-to-ogive
length (CBTO), mm.

Analysis.description:
An analysis of several groups the hunter saved, worked out again from
the groups whenever it is opened.

id.description: The analysis's id, unique among analyses.

group_ids.description:
Its groups (of the file's `groups`), in the hunter's order; ones
deleted since are skipped.

settings.description:
How the app shows it, as the app's own JSON object; a reader may
ignore it.

updated_at.description: When the record was last changed, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

AnalysisKind.description: What a saved analysis does with its groups.

oneOf.description: Groups side by side, tested against each other.
The groups' shots pooled into one group.
A ladder's rungs, ranked.

kind.description: What kind of record it was.

deleted_at.description: When it was deleted, in milliseconds since 1970 (UTC).

RecordKind.description: The kinds of the hunter's records.

CatalogDetails.description: What the records name from the app's built-in catalog.

calibers.description: The calibers named by rifles and bullets (their `caliber`).

scopes.description: The catalog scopes named by rifles (their `scope_id`).

reticles.description: The catalog reticles named by rifles and scopes (their `reticle_id`).

CaliberDetails.description: A caliber, as a rifle's or bullet's `caliber` names it.

bullet_diameter_mm.description: The bullet diameter the caliber takes, mm.

ScopeDetails.description: A catalog scope, as a rifle's `scope_id` names it.

reticle_reference_magnification.description:
For second-focal-plane scopes: the magnification at which the
reticle's published dimensions are true.

click_value.description: Per click, in `click_unit`; `null` when the maker doesn't publish it.

fov_m_at_100m.description:
Field of view in metres at 100 m, at the lowest and the highest
magnification.

illuminated.description: Whether the reticle can be lit.

source_url.description: Where the data was taken from.
